spans.s: व्हिट्ने [ WHITNEY, WILLIAM DWIGHT, 1827-1894] a sound scholar of Vedic grammar who has, besides some books on Ling- uistic studies, written a work on Vedic Grammar and edited the Atharvaveda

श श् (1) a sibilant letter of the palatal class, possessed of the properties, श्वासानुप्रदान, अघोष and कण्ठविवृतत्व; (2) the initial indicatory ( इत् ) letter श् of a non-taddhita affix in Panini's grammar, which is dropped; (3) substitute for च्छ् when followed by an affix beginning with a nasal con- sonant; e.g प्रश्न:, cf.
;(4) substitute for स् when followed by श् or any palatal letter;e.g. वृक्षश्छादयति वृक्षश्शेते Kas.on
